fusions.name: Slack Water
fusions.desc: Sends a slow ripple that deals 12 water damage to the first enemy it meets, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it [Enervated] for 8 seconds, so its health, mana and stamina return slower.

fusions.name: Flat Water
fusions.desc: Sends a wave out from you that deals 28 water damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. It ignores resistances and leaves them [Soaked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Off the Back
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.

fusions.name: Drift Paddle
fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank your health regenerates 15% faster, from silver your stamina recovers 12% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.
